data.text:
[2:28PM] #OkotaIsolo #TrafficUpdate 

 The stretch from Cele towards Pako is experiencing good vehicular movement, with similar conditions observed on the return journey. Ago Palace Road, in both inward and outward directions towards Apple Junction, is also flowing well.
Vehicular movement along Nwachukwu Drive to connect Cele is smooth, mirroring the return journey. The Cele linked bridge, both for inward travel to Ijesha and its return, is also experiencing good flow.

 Within the inner parts of Ire Akari to Osolo Road, traffic is moving freely in both directions. Similarly, Ibeh Road Apata, from Transformer Junction inward to Ilasa underbridge service lane, is clear, as is the corresponding return route.
Oke Afa, specifically the stretch towards Lasutech Roundabout, is currently experiencing good vehicular movement in both directions.

 Daleko Bridge, for the inward journey towards Palm Avenue Junction and its return, also remains clear. Finally, the area around Five Stars, extending towards the Ijesha Expressway, including both the main carriageways and service lanes, is operating efficiently. At present, there are no reported impediments in these areas. 

#FollowLASTMA
